name: Battleground Events
description: Defines and describes the battleground event indexes (main event1 + sub event2) used on each battleground map. Rows in creature_battleground and gameobject_battleground must reference an event pair defined here; battleground scripts (de)activate whole events, (de)spawning all objects assigned to them together.

fields.name: Description
fields.help: Human readable description of what this event represents (e.g. a node state).
